en: The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika) and the Triplet of Seeing as Cause (Dassanahetuttika).

Dependent on a state that is unwholesome, not to be abandoned by vision, and has roots, there arises a state that is unwholesome and to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is unwholesome, not to be abandoned by cultivation, and has roots, there arises a state that is unwholesome and to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, an indeterminate state whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three under root;
three under object … pe … nine under conascence … pe … nine under dependence … pe … [nine] under kamma … pe … nine under path … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
